name: footguns
description:
A deliberately-broken fixture carrying the three real-world foot-guns preview is built to catch — used by preview-footguns.test.ts as the regression proof. NOT a shipped example; lives under __tests__/fixtures so it never reaches the examples allowlist.

FOOT-GUN 1 (decorative-var): `appEnv` is declared in vars and read ONLY in the build phase's description, never threaded into the build COMMAND — the exact 'a stage build that's really dev' bug.
FOOT-GUN 2 (unbound ${ref} in code.run): the build command interpolates ${buildFlags}, which no var/input/as produces — it renders as a literal `${buildFlags}` in the shell command.
FOOT-GUN 3 (unbound ${ref} in prompt): the notify prompt interpolates ${releaseReport}, which nothing produces — the literal-passthrough that once shipped a QA report containing a raw `${releaseReport}`.

phases.name: build
phases.description: Builds the project for the ${appEnv} environment.

phases.name: notify
phases.prompt: Post the build result for ${repo} to ${releaseReport}. Summarize what shipped.
